status: one-shot diagnostic, not a benchmark percentile
method: A temporary Vitest partial mock wrapped resolveHistoricalSchedulingEvidence and accumulated call count and performance.now() self-time. The deterministic fixture was created outside the full getAnalyticsSummary timer. One call was measured before and one after request-scoped memoization. The temporary test was removed afterward; no production timing instrumentation was added.

parityProof.scope: SHA256 of the complete serialized Analytics All summary matched before and after memoization on the same deterministic 50,000-review stress fixture.
parityProof.fixtureCases: The stress fixture includes corrected attempts, equal-timestamp ties, captured evidence, legacy-derived evidence, and unknown evidence. The fixture test asserts those cases; the entire-summary digest covers their combined output.
parityProof.focusedTests: Four Analytics test files passed, 115 tests total: analytics-service, review-cohorts, historical-presentation, and chart-data. These include corrected and restored chronology, lexical ID ties, custom captured profiles, legacy compatibility, and unknown evidence.
parityProof.checkedInReference: analytics-service.test.ts compares the complete Analytics All summary for the deterministic 5,000-review standard fixture with the frozen pre-optimization digest 65e87aaa707bbcc08f6925e9ef7bddd6ee68eb8371f97b6173eedd301428b161. The test asserts corrected revisions, timestamp ties, and captured/legacy-derived/unknown evidence before comparing the digest; its focused run passed.

cacheSafetyAudit.scope: The Map is constructed inside getAnalyticsSummary for one invocation. A hit requires equal rating, reviewedAt epoch, fsrsReviewLog, schedulingEvidenceKind, schedulerProfileJson, and preCardJson for the same attempt ID.
cacheSafetyAudit.callSites: The summary passes this resolver to repeat-review pairing, historical presentation, stability points, overdue reconstruction, and stability readiness. Topic recall readiness checks valid rating, observed correctness, and topic labels only; it does not resolve scheduling evidence. Domain functions retain the original pure resolver as a default for other callers.
cacheSafetyAudit.consumerMutation: Reviewed repeat-review pairs, historical memory rows, stability points, and overdue reconstruction. They read kind, estimate, and preCard/postCard fields; overdue reconstruction stores a postCard reference as currentCard and only reads its dueAt. No consumer writes to cached evidence, nested cards, or parsed log/profile objects.

interpretation: The exact serialized Analytics All output digest matched the saved stress reference before and after the change. The observed single-call elapsed time fell by about 41%; use the repeated local and packaged runs for reported p50/p95 latency.
